messages.content: If someone replies STOP to one of my texts, do I have to take them off my list myself?

No, you don't. When someone replies STOP, they're opted out automatically and won't get your future texts, so there's nothing to remove by hand.

Keeping each text short and clear about who is sending it helps keep opt-outs low.
